info.title: How we calculate portfolio value
info.body:
The Total Portfolio Value is calculated by adding up the value of all asset values and Algo available in your accounts, excluding Watch Accounts.

Asset values are calculated based on daily values fetched from several ecosystem partners.  Since some asset values are not available, the Total Portfolio Value should be considered an estimation.

security.enable_rekey_support_description: Once you enable this, you can confirm transaction requests to rekey your account. This will give control of your account to another address.
security.biometric_error_message: We were unable to authenticate you.  Please try again.
security.enable_asset_freeze_support_description: Once you enable this, you can confirm transaction requests to freeze or unfreeze assets on accounts. This may prevent the target account from transacting with the specified asset.
security.shake_to_lock_description: Automatically lock the wallet when the phone is shaken or jerked sharply. Useful if the phone is snatched or you want a quick way to lock from any screen.
security.shake_to_lock_info_body: When this is on, Pera listens for sudden movement using the phone's motion sensor while you have the wallet open. A hard shake or sharp jerk will instantly lock the wallet, so you can shake your phone to lock it in a hurry. Requires PIN to be enabled.
security.shake_to_lock_requires_pin: Enable PIN to use this feature.
security.duress_pin_description: An alternative PIN that silently wipes the wallet when entered at the lock screen. Wiped data cannot be recovered — make sure you have your recovery passphrase backed up before enabling this.
security.duress_pin_info_body:
Set up an alternative PIN you can enter under duress. If you ever enter it at the lock screen instead of your real PIN, Pera will silently delete all of your accounts and replace them with a fresh empty wallet so it looks like you simply have no funds. Keep biometrics on if you like — under duress, cancel the biometric prompt and type the duress PIN by hand. The duress PIN must be different from your regular PIN.

Important: a duress wipe is permanent. Anything stored only on this device (accounts you haven't backed up elsewhere) cannot be recovered afterwards. Make sure you have your recovery passphrase saved before turning this on.
security.duress_pin_requires_pin: Enable PIN to use this feature.
security.duress_pin_matches_regular: Your duress PIN must be different from your regular PIN.

disclaimer.intro: Pera Wallet gives you access to third-party staking services. When you use these services, you work directly with a provider that stakes your digital assets for transaction validation on the Algorand network.

disclaimer.bullet_no_custody: Pera never takes custody of rewards or assets and has no control over Proof-of-Stake networks where validation rights may be delegated.
disclaimer.bullet_no_guarantee: Pera does not guarantee you will receive staking rewards or any specific reward rates.
disclaimer.bullet_provider_failures: Pera is not responsible for staking provider failures to transfer rewards or losses due to risks such as slashing.

help.title: Staking Types
help.liquid_description: Liquid staking applications allow users to stake their Algo while maintaining liquidity. The typical process asks users to deposit Algo and mint new tokens that represent ownership and value of staked Algo, and can be used across the <0>DeFi ecosystem</0>.
help.pools_description: Staking pools enable groups of individuals to participate in consensus together. Users can stake Algo to a validator and get rewarded based on validator rewards. Options like DEX liquidity pool staking are also available.
help.delegated_description: Delegated staking involves using a third-party to run a node on your behalf while your Algo remains in your wallet. This is useful for users who want to secure the network and collect rewards without running their own node.

introduction.title: Swap in Pera
introduction.description: Pera Wallet provides an easy and fast way to swap assets. With P.E.R.A., swap requests are intelligently routed across multiple Algorand based decentralized exchanges to secure the best available price.

troubleshooting.title: Having Ledger connection issues?
troubleshooting.description: If you are having issues pairing or using your Ledger device, check the steps below.
troubleshooting.pairing_step_1: Make sure that your Ledger device is on and has Bluetooth enabled.
troubleshooting.pairing_step_2: Open the Algorand app on your Ledger.
troubleshooting.pairing_step_3: If the Algorand app is not installed, install it from Ledger Live.
troubleshooting.issue_unlocked: Make sure the device is unlocked, nearby and has Bluetooth enabled. If problems persist, remove the device from your phone's Bluetooth settings and re-pair it following the Pera Wallet instructions.
troubleshooting.issue_bluetooth: Bluetooth must be enabled on your device in order to search for nearby Ledger devices.
troubleshooting.issue_permissions: Bluetooth scan permission needs to be granted in order to search for nearby Ledgers.
troubleshooting.issue_unsupported: Pera supports Ledger Nano X, Stax, Flex, and Nano Gen5.
troubleshooting.tip_unlocked: Make sure the device is unlocked
troubleshooting.tip_nearby: Make sure the device is nearby
troubleshooting.tip_app_open: Make sure the Algorand app is open on your Ledger
troubleshooting.tip_repair: If problems persist, try re-pairing the device from Settings
